title: [SOLVED] Can Q Sprite be used with events?

posts.author: NoClue
posts.body:
So I previously tried to use Q Sprite with events to give larger than average enemies more than 3 frames of animation, but it seemed like the program only worked with the player character, since if I set up everything exactly the same for enemies as I did the character, it would only ever play three frames. Now I'm not interested in the ABS or anything like that. PVGames sprites use 8 frames instead of 3 and it seems like they might have made it work, so I would like to know how, if it was possible. I can't find any tutorials on using Q Sprite with events, they all seem to be focused around using it with the player character.
EDIT: I FIGURED IT OUT. So here's something nobody tells you about RPG Maker MV with Q plugins: the game defaults event sprites back to the initial pose after enough time has passed, and this is based on the speed given to the event. This means if you want to use 8 frames, you need to turn up the animation speed A LOT in QSprite Editor if you don't want them to be jittery. I had turned it from 10 to 7 for some of the running animations, but it turns out you actually want it to be way higher or slower depending on the movement speed. If you have 8 animations and you want to play them on an event moving at Speed 4: Normal, you want the QSprite Editor speed to be 3. If your event is moving at Speed 3: x2 Slower, you want the QSprite Editor speed to be 5. If you think it looks awkward at those speeds, you need to use fewer frames of animation. 6 frames of animation on QSprite Editor can be set to 4, and on RPG Maker MV you can then have it at Speed 4: Normal.
Maybe there's a way to loop sprites better so that you don't have to worry about this, but I don't know it yet. Also before anyone points out that there's an auto-adjust option, I tried that already, it had 0 effect. Maybe there's more than clicking the button and setting it as true in the plugin, but that's not included in the documentation.
